terms.label: Physics
terms.definition: The natural science that studies matter, energy, and their interactions.

terms.label: Classical mechanics
terms.definition: The study of motion and forces for macroscopic objects at non-relativistic speeds.

terms.label: Kinematics
terms.definition: Branch of mechanics describing motion without regard to its causes.

terms.label: Dynamics
terms.definition: Branch of mechanics concerned with the motion of bodies under the action of forces.

terms.label: Lagrangian mechanics
terms.definition: Reformulation of classical mechanics using the principle of least action.

terms.label: Hamiltonian mechanics
terms.definition: Reformulation of classical mechanics using canonical coordinates and the Hamiltonian function.

terms.label: Electromagnetism
terms.definition: The physics of electric and magnetic fields and their interactions with matter.

terms.label: Maxwell equations
terms.definition: A set of partial differential equations describing the behavior of electric and magnetic fields.

terms.label: Thermodynamics
terms.definition: The study of heat, work, temperature, and energy transfer in physical systems.

terms.label: Statistical mechanics
terms.definition: The application of probability theory and statistics to solve physical problems.

terms.label: Entropy
terms.definition: A measure of the number of possible microscopic configurations of a thermodynamic system.

terms.label: Relativity
terms.definition: The physics of space and time as described by Einstein's theories.

terms.label: Special relativity
terms.definition: The theory of the structure of spacetime in the absence of gravity.

terms.label: General relativity
terms.definition: The geometric theory of gravitation published by Albert Einstein in 1915.

terms.label: Spacetime
terms.definition: A mathematical model that fuses the three dimensions of space and the one dimension of time.

terms.label: Black hole
terms.definition: A region of spacetime where gravity is so strong that nothing can escape from it.

terms.label: Quantum mechanics
terms.definition: The fundamental theory in physics describing nature at the smallest scales of energy levels.

terms.label: Optics
terms.definition: The branch of physics that studies the behavior and properties of light.

terms.label: Wave optics
terms.definition: The study of light based on the wave nature of electromagnetic radiation.

terms.label: Particle physics
terms.definition: The study of the elementary constituents of matter and radiation.
